verdict.rationale: Salv bounds automatic resolution by policy. Clearance rules auto-close only alerts that meet conditions you set, and every auto-close stays on the audit record. AI-Powered Insights is explicitly informational and never closes an alert or makes the decision, so any alert not cleared by policy stays with human analysts, who work it through cases with an assignee and status. Missing for 10: explicit risk-based or ambiguity-based escalation routing (e.g., auto-assigning high-risk hits to a senior reviewer), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how clearance-rule limits behave in practice.
